question: Will Binance announce it will cover 100% of user fund losses from the Oct 29 exploit within the next 3 days?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if Binance publishes an official announcement on its official channels (blog, press release, or official social media account) strictly after 2026-10-29T21:22:00Z and at or before 2026-11-01T21:22:00Z confirming that it will cover 100% of user fund losses stemming from the October 29, 2026 exploit.
- "No": Wins if no such official announcement is made by Binance strictly after 2026-10-29T21:22:00Z and at or before 2026-11-01T21:22:00Z confirming that it will cover 100% of user fund losses stemming from the October 29, 2026 exploit.

Clarifications:
- An announcement qualifies only if it explicitly commits to covering 100% of affected user fund losses from the October 29, 2026 exploit; partial coverage pledges, general SAFU fund references, or statements that funds are unaffected do not satisfy the "Yes" condition.
